newsitem.title: GERMANY: Augsburg Airways drops St Tropez after French flight.
newsitem.headline: Augsburg Airways drops St Tropez after French flight.

text.p: German regional airline Augsburg Airways said it has scrapped plans for a weekly flight to St Tropez this summer following a ban by French authorities.
The airline would instead fly to the German North Sea island of Sylt on Sundays from June 15 to September 28.

Augsburg Airways was forced to drop its inaugural flight to St Tropez on April 6 after the French transport ministry banned landings by aircraft weighing more than 5.7 tonnes or with more than 10 seats.

Ongoing talks between the airline, Deutsche Lufthansa AG and Crossair and French authorities showed no signs of reaching an agreement, a statement said. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
